title: Ethiopian Yeast-Free Flatbread (Injera)
description: Traditional Ethiopian flatbread made without yeast, perfect for a vegetarian snack or side dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine oats and warm water.
Let the mixture sit for 2-3 hours, allowing it to thicken.
Add spice mix and salt to the mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a greased 12-inch skillet or oven-safe pan.
Cook over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, until the bottom is set.
Transfer the pan to the oven and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20-25 minutes, until the top is crispy.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
